text:
elaine: Heads up — monitoring alerted: 18 RDS snapshots created in the last 36m with `Encrypted: false`. Appears backup service account IAM was modified. Snap IDs: snap-prod-20260320-01..18. CloudTrail shows CreateDBSnapshot succeeded but no corresponding KMS Encrypt calls. @samir @devon

samir: I'm oncall, taking it. Are these all in us-west-2? Any S3 artifacts?

devon: Confirmed us-west-2. These are RDS automated snapshots created by our backup job. I see `encrypted: false` on those snapshot records. PR #4321 that touched backup-sa policies merged ~2h ago by @alex — the policy diff removed a KMS action unexpectedly.

alex: I reverted the PR in prod just now (reopened the rollback PR). That change was meant to tighten S3 access — I must have botched a policy variable. Posting diff below. Sorry, my fault.

maria: CloudTrail lookup: `ModifyRolePolicy` for role `backup-sa` at 2012345560 by alex@github-app. Diff snippet:
```json
- "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
+ "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject"]
```
Looks like kms actions were dropped and replaced.

samir: Triage plan (short):
1) Prevent further unencrypted snapshots: lock role and block backup job until creds rotated.
2) Re-encrypt: copy affected snapshots to new CMK-backed snapshots (aws rds copy-db-snapshot --kms-key-id).
3) Re-ingest copies into S3 with SSE-KMS for offsite backup.
4) Forensic audit: CloudTrail + S3 access logs + KMS CloudWatch logs.
Who can run snapshot copies and has KMS grant?

devon: I can run copies but we need a temporary grant for role `backup-copy-role` on alias/rd-prod-cmk. @kms-bot can you create short-lived grant?

kms-bot: Grant request acknowledged. Created temporary grant id `G-9f3a` for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-copy-role. Expires in 60m.

alex: Also flag: backup agent v0.9.2 (deployed on backup-host-*) caches creds in /var/tmp for 30m — that's CVE-2026-1459 (credential caching vulnerability). We should rotate service account creds and bump agent to 0.9.4. I'm opening a vuln PR to patch images.

elaine: Action items summarised: rotate backup-sa credentials immediately, lock PRs touching backup policies, create KMS grant (done), copy snapshots to CMK-backed copies, re-ingest to SSE-KMS S3, run audit. Timeline: creds rotated now, copies within 2h, full audit within 24h. Assigning sec+infra.

maria: Quick commands I'm running (example):
```
aws rds copy-db-snapshot \
  --source-region us-west-2 \
  --source-db-snapshot-identifier snap-prod-20260320-01 \
  --target-db-snapshot-identifier snap-prod-20260320-01-reenc \
  --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/rdb-prod
```
Copy returned `pending-copy`. Logging progress to /tmp/backup-copy.log.

devon: Starting batch copies 1..6. copy-db-snapshot returned `pending-copy` for each. I'll stream status and errors to the thread.

samir: IR notes: mark as Sev3 incident for now. Notified compliance. Data classification: these DBs are PII-lite (user handles + email hash). No evidence of exfil in initial CloudTrail review — only calls from backup hosts and our CI runner. But we need to treat creds as potentially compromised until rotation.

alex: No external IPs accessed the snapshots. CloudTrail shows calls only from backup-host-* EC2 instances. Still rotate keys and rotate any IAM long-lived credentials. I'll push hotfix to images and start rolling upgrade to 0.9.4.

security-oncall: Incident ticket INC-2026-1423 created and assigned to sec+infra. Added retention+lock on CloudTrail logs for this incident. Will enable S3 object-level logging for reingested backups.

elaine: Short-term mitigation suggestion: enable client-side envelope encryption on backup pipeline (we can wrap plaintext payloads with our own KMS-generated DEK) until all agents are upgraded. That eliminates reliance on host agent SSE behavior.

maria: Added CI unit test in infra repo to assert `backup-sa` policy includes `kms:Encrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` on alias/rdb-prod. PR #4333 created. Also added an alert for snapshot records with `Encrypted: false`.

samir: After successful copy+verify, schedule deletion of the unencrypted snapshots (per retention/compliance) and preserve copies for forensics. Ensure evidence chain: annotate copied snapshot IDs, who performed copy, and associated CloudTrail entries.

devon: Batch 1/18 done (6 copies). No errors so far. Uploading logs to secure bucket `s3://redwood-sec-incident/INC-2026-1423/backup-copy.log`.

elaine: Good. Keep this thread updated with copy completion and any unexpected errors. Once all copies verified, create a small postmortem with root cause: human policy churn + missing infra unit test + vulnerable agent caching. Todo: tighten PR review for IAM changes touching kms actions. :eyes: :lock:
